classification.difficultyReason: Reverses compound depreciation over different periods and compares average annual losses using unrounded earlier values.

content.prompt: Ms Rinoldis’ seven-year-old car is worth $\$5600$, and has been depreciating at $22.5\%$ p.a.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How much, correct to the nearest dollar, was it worth four years ago?

answer.worked:
The annual multiplier is $1-0.225=0.775$. Let $V$ be its value four years ago.

$$\begin{align*}5600&=V(0.775)^4\\V&=\frac{5600}{(0.775)^4}\\V&\approx\$15\,523\end{align*}$$

Correct to the nearest dollar.

children.label: b
children.prompt: How much, correct to the nearest dollar, was it worth seven years ago?

answer.worked:
Let $P$ be the car’s original value.

$$\begin{align*}5600&=P(0.775)^7\\P&=\frac{5600}{(0.775)^7}\\P&\approx\$33\,348\end{align*}$$

Correct to the nearest dollar.

children.label: c
children.prompt: What is the total percentage reduction in value on the car over the seven-year period? Give your answer to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked:
The fraction of the original value remaining is $(0.775)^7$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage reduction}&=\bigl(1-(0.775)^7\bigr)\times100\%\\\text{Percentage reduction}&\approx83.2\%\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: What was the average reduction in value in dollars per year over the seven-year period? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
Use the unrounded original value from part b.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Average annual reduction}&=\frac{5600/(0.775)^7-5600}{7}\\\text{Average annual reduction}&\approx\$3964.07\text{ per year}\end{align*}$$

children.label: e
children.prompt: Ms Rinoldis, however, only bought the car four years ago, at its depreciated value at that time.

children.label: i
children.prompt: What has been Ms Rinoldis’ average loss in dollars per year over the four years she has owned the car? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
Use the unrounded purchase value from part a.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Average annual loss}&=\frac{5600/(0.775)^4-5600}{4}\\\text{Average annual loss}&\approx\$2480.80\text{ per year}\end{align*}$$

children.label: ii
children.prompt: What was the average loss in dollars per year over the first three years of the car’s life? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
The first three years end when Ms Rinoldis buys the car. Use the unrounded values from parts a and b.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Average annual loss}&=\frac{5600/(0.775)^7-5600/(0.775)^4}{3}\\\text{Average annual loss}&\approx\$5941.76\text{ per year}\end{align*}$$
